top_issues: Balance legend row ('On-chain $0.00 / Reserve $40.00 / Secured $0.00 / Promised $115.00') has five dot-colored labels in one line; the bar colors are near-identical green/green/violet and hard to attribute

'How to read this' explainer permanently occupies prime first-screen space; it teaches the bar system but delays the actual balance
fixes: Differentiate the four legend segments with clearly distinct hues or add segment labels directly on the bar
Normalize decimal separator to '.' everywhere
Collapse the explainer by default behind a small '?' affordance after first dismissal

top_issues: Full-length raw address '0x92c2d7c32d7837f7a94aa36be58d7198a1f998a6ab1b0609737326729cb2cbf0' renders in tiny low-contrast type under the To field; reads as noise, invites paste errors
Before/After bars in 'Your account with H1' are unlabeled by segment color; user must infer green=violet meaning again

fixes: Truncate address to 0x92c2…2cbf0 with a copy/expand control
Add mini-legend or segment ticks to the Before/After bars
Show the alternative route's fee inline ('other route: 0.00000075') so the choice is informed

top_issues: 'Settled 04:41:11 in 8 s' mixes clock time and duration with the duration only in green — easy to misread as a timestamp pair

Add a copy button next to the Proof hash
Increase backdrop opacity to ~70% to isolate the modal

Hide capacity/prepare controls behind an advanced section; default to a plain QR + amount + note
Constrain the form column and add a live preview of the payment link beside it

top_issues: Collateral tariff paragraph ('0.1 WETH base + 0 WETH gas + 1 bps…') is dense legalese in the middle of a trade flow; a trader cannot act on it
'You receive 0.039992' in dim gray reads like a disabled value, not the primary output

Render the receive amount in full-brightness white at the same size as 'You pay'

top_issues: A tooltip floats mid-screen ('Account opening requested with zero credit…') disconnected from any anchor; its cause is unclear

'They owe you, uncovered $90.00' in the right card vs '+90.00 they owe you' in the left card — same fact, two labels, different phrasing

Unify on one term ('uncovered amount you are owed') in both cards
Label the WETH bar's tick or remove the empty lane by default

top_issues: '7 movements' count floats far right of the title with no grouping (no date sections beyond 'Today'); sparse page bottom-left

'Swap placed 18.58 USDC · open' shows an amount that is neither sent nor received — ambiguous direction

Cap the preview card's px display to the card width with 'clipped' notation

'WHAT HAPPENS' card explains only the happy path in one sentence; no fee, no timing, no failure mode
Recipient entity field with raw '0x… entity id' placeholder exposes internal jargon on a consumer flow

Show fee and estimated time in the WHAT HAPPENS card ('posts $25 collateral on-chain · ~1 block')
Default the recipient to yourself and hide the raw id field behind 'Pay someone else'

'NEEDS ATTENTION · Nothing waiting on you' occupies a full card for an empty state
fixes: Normalize the grid to equal card sizes or list layout
Align terminology with Home ('Secured: $40.00')
Collapse the empty attention card to a single status line

top_issues: Right column mixes five unrelated actions (faucet, credit extend, receive, gas, reserve) in one tall stack with 'Extend credit limit' as the visually dominant CTA — wrong emphasis for an Assets page
'Depository may pull 0.00' allowance line is unexplained and alarming in phrasing
Faucet token grid (USDC/WETH/USDT/TRX/SUN) sits directly above the collateral prepare card with no separation of concerns

Rename to 'Exchange allowance: 0.00' with an info tooltip
Group faucet in its own bordered card with its own submit

H1 POOL card shows all zeros with no explanation of what the pool is or what others have lent
Term selection (1 hour / 1 day / 1 month) as bordered inputs looks like text fields, not segmented control
fixes: Default to a sane rate (e.g. 5 bps) and show an APR badge with a sanity warning above 50%
Populate the pool card with market context or an explicit 'Empty pool — your offer may wait' note
Convert term to a segmented control

top_issues: 'Self-issued (its id is the hash of its board)' and 'A lazy entity is identified by the hash of its board. Register it on the EntityProvider…' — pure protocol jargon with no user benefit stated
Screen is mostly empty; no shares, no members list, no actions besides reading
'TAKE CONTROL OF ANOTHER ENTITY' heading sounds adversarial for what is an empty state
fixes: Rewrite copy in user terms ('This wallet is controlled by your single key. Add co-signers for shared control.')
Offer a primary action ('Add co-signer') instead of a static card
Rename the takeover card to 'Linked entities'

top_issues: PER COUNTERPARTY card overflows: '…you in 1 d · open → Manage → Dispute' text is clipped at the card edge
'Collateral behind what you are owed $0.00' is a triple-negative-feeling label for the most important risk number
Enforceable $40.00 hero (green reserve) sits directly above the violet 'Promised $90.00' — the riskier number is visually larger context but not escalated
fixes: Fix the counterparty card's text wrap/overflow and give the dispute path its own button
Rename to 'Uncovered amount at risk: $90.00' and color it consistently with the risk palette
Add a one-line verdict banner ('$90 of your $130 is only a promise') above the key/value stack

top_issues: Account table columns 'LINES OUT-…' and '115.50·0.0…' are clipped mid-word; the densest data on the screen is unreadable
Book panel overlaps/bleeds behind the jump overlay edge in 17 and is clipped at the right edge here ('live · relay' cut)
Legend row with seven color words under the table duplicates the unreadable-column problem instead of annotating the table
fixes: Widen the table or abbreviate headers ('OUT'); show truncated numeric columns in full on hover
Give the book panel its own fixed right column with padding
Attach small color ticks to the table headers instead of a detached legend

top_issues: Same clipped book panel behind the command palette ('live · relay', right-edge cut) — the overlay doesn't fully mask the underlying layout issues
Palette lacks keyboard-hint footer (↑↓ navigate · ↵ select) and fuzzy-search affordance visibility
Descriptions on the right ('send money', 'invoice, QR') are good but inconsistent granularity; some rows have none (Home, Desk… actually Desk has one) — 'Home' has none
fixes: Raise overlay backdrop opacity so clipped panels don't leak through
Add a standard ⌘K footer hint bar
Ensure every palette row carries a description

overall.verdict: A visually coherent, premium-feeling wallet with a genuinely novel one-scale bar system and strong provability framing, dragged down by jargon (credit/collateral/entity/board), repeated clipped text in dense panels, and a cross-network swap flow that strands the user mid-task. Trust signals are excellent; task completion for non-experts is not.
priority_fixes: Fix all clipped/overflowing text (16-desk table columns, 15-sovereignty counterparty card, 17-palette backdrop leak)
Replace jargon copy with user language across 05b-swap-cross, 14-ownership, 12-assets ('credit', 'entity id', 'lazy entity', 'collateral behind what you are owed')
Rescue the cross-network swap flow (05b): anchor tooltips, collapse the prepare-to-receive block, and put the disabled-CTA reason next to the button
Unify money terminology and number formatting across screens (secured vs 'yours whatever a hub does', comma vs dot decimals, 'they owe you' vs 'uncovered')
Give every directionless row and unlabeled bar a meaning: signed amounts on swap/activity rows and inline legend ticks on all segment bars
